/* SepoaApprovalService.doQuery */ SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT GWGL.HOUSE_CODE , GWGL.COMPANY_CODE , SIAD.RE_FLAG , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ , GWGL.APP_TYPE , GWGL.APP_SUBJECT , GWGL.APP_CONTENTS
, 'L04' AS APP_STATUS
, GWGL.APP_STATUS
, GWGL.APP_STATUS
, GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY2 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY3 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY4 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY5 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY6 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY7 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY8 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY9 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY10 , GWGL.APP_USER_DATE AS REQ_DATE , GWGL.APP_USER_TIME AS REQ_TIME , GWGL.APP_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , REQ_USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USMT.POSITION AS REQ_USER_POSITION , REQ_USMT.DEPT AS REQ_USER_DEPT , CASE ${session.LANGUAGE} WHEN 'KO' THEN REQ_DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC ELSE REQ_DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG END AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ , GWLN.APP_STAGE , GWLN.APP_TYPE AS APP_LN_TYPE , GWLN.APP_METHOD , GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID AS TAREGT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_DATE , GWLN.ACCEPT_TIME , GWLN.ACCEPT_REASON , CASE WHEN APP_METHOD = '03' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END REFERENCE_STATUS FROM SGWGL GWGL INNER JOIN SGWLN GWLN ON GWLN.HOUSE_CODE = GWGL.HOUSE_CODE AND GWLN.COMPANY_CODE = GWGL.COMPANY_CODE AND GWLN.APP_NO = GWGL.APP_NO AND GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ = GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT REQ_USMT ON REQ_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = GWGL.HOUSE_CODE AND REQ_USMT.USER_ID = GWGL.APP_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT REQ_DEPT ON REQ_DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = REQ_USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND REQ_DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = REQ_USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND REQ_DEPT.DEPT = REQ_USMT.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SMAND MAND ON REQ_USMT.HOUSE_CODE = MAND.HOUSE_CODE AND REQ_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = MAND.COMPANY_CODE AND REQ_USMT.COMPANY_CODE = MAND.RECE_COMPANY_CODE AND RECE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND ${current.DATE} BETWEEN MAND.START_DATE AND MAND.END_DATE AND MAND.MAND_TYPE = '01' LEFT OUTER JOIN SSIAD SIAD ON GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = SIAD.HOUSE_CODE AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = SIAD.COMPANY_CODE AND GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 = SIAD.SMR_NUMBER WHERE GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(GWGL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND GWGL.APP_TYPE IN ($INS{F_APP_TYPE})
AND ((GWLN.APP_USER_ID = $S{APP_USER_ID}) OR (MAND.GIVE_USER_ID IN (GWLN.APP_USER_ID))) AND ( GWLN.APP_METHOD = '04' AND GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ = GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE AND GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS = 'L04' )
AND (($S{APP_USER_ID} IN (GWLN.APP_USER_ID)) OR (MAND.GIVE_USER_ID IN (GWLN.APP_USER_ID))) AND ( GWLN.APP_METHOD = '04' AND CONVERT(decimal, GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ) <= CONVERT(decimal, GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE ) AND GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS IN ('L02', 'L03', 'L05') )
AND ($S{APP_USER_ID} IN (GWLN.APP_USER_ID)) AND ( GWLN.APP_METHOD = '03' AND GWGL.APP_STATUS IN ('I','F', 'R') )
) A WHERE (1=1 AND UPPER(A.APP_NO) like (CONCAT('%', #DB_OWNER#NVL(UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}), ''), '%')) OR UPPER(A.APP_SUBJECT) like (CONCAT('%', #DB_OWNER#NVL(UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}), ''), '%')) OR UPPER(A.REQ_USER_NAME) like (CONCAT('%', #DB_OWNER#NVL(UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}), ''), '%'))
AND A.APP_LINE_SEQ = '1'
) ORDER BY A.REQ_DATE DESC, A.REQ_TIME DESC, A.APP_NO, A.APP_NO_SEQ

/* SepoaApprovalService.getAppLine */ SELECT DISTINCT CAST(GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ AS DECIMAL) AS "DEC" ,GWLN.HOUSE_CODE , GWLN.COMPANY_CODE , GWLN.APP_NO , GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ , GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ , GWLN.APP_STAGE , GWLN.APP_TYPE , GWLN.APP_METHOD , GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(GWLN.HOUSE_CODE, GWLN.COMPANY_CODE, GWLN.APP_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS APP_USER_NAME , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTCODE(GWLN.HOUSE_CODE, GWLN.COMPANY_CODE, GWLN.APP_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS APP_USER_DEPT_CODE , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(GWLN.HOUSE_CODE, GWLN.COMPANY_CODE, GWLN.APP_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS APP_USER_DEPT_NAME , GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(GWLN.HOUSE_CODE, GWLN.COMPANY_CODE, GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ACCEPT_USER_NAME , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTCODE(GWLN.HOUSE_CODE, GWLN.COMPANY_CODE, GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ACCEPT_USER_DEPT_CODE , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERDEPTNAME(GWLN.HOUSE_CODE, GWLN.COMPANY_CODE, GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS ACCEPT_USER_DEPT_NAME , GWLN.ACCEPT_DATE , GWLN.ACCEPT_TIME , GWLN.ACCEPT_REASON FROM SGWLN GWLN LEFT OUTER JOIN SMAND MAND ON GWLN.HOUSE_CODE = MAND.HOUSE_CODE AND GWLN.COMPANY_CODE = MAND.COMPANY_CODE AND GWLN.APP_USER_ID = MAND.GIVE_USER_ID AND GWLN.COMPANY_CODE = MAND.GIVE_COMPANY_CODE AND GWLN.COMPANY_CODE = MAND.RECE_COMPANY_CODE AND ${current.DATE} BETWEEN MAND.START_DATE AND MAND.END_DATE AND MAND.MAND_TYPE = '01' WHERE GWLN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWLN.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND GWLN.APP_NO= ${APP_NO} AND GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ = ${APP_NO_SEQ} AND GWLN.APP_TYPE != 'L06' ORDER BY CAST(GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ AS DECIMAL)

/* SepoaApprovalService.doQueryApprovalInfo */ SELECT GWGL.HOUSE_CODE , GWGL.COMPANY_CODE , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ , GWGL.APP_TYPE , GWGL.APP_STATUS , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY2 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY3 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY4 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY5 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY6 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY7 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY8 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY9 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY10 , GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ , GWLN.APP_STAGE , GWLN.APP_METHOD , GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_DATE , GWLN.ACCEPT_TIME , GWLN.ACCEPT_REASON FROM SGWGL GWGL INNER JOIN SGWLN GWLN ON GWLN.HOUSE_CODE = GWGL.HOUSE_CODE AND GWLN.COMPANY_CODE = GWGL.COMPANY_CODE AND GWLN.APP_NO = GWGL.APP_NO AND GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ = GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ WHERE GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND GWGL.APP_NO= ${APP_NO} AND GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ = ${APP_NO_SEQ} ORDER BY CAST(GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ AS DECIMAL)

/* SepoaApprovalService.doQueryDelegation */ SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,MAND_TYPE ,GIVE_COMPANY_CODE ,GIVE_USER_ID ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME('#HOUSE_CODE#', '#COMPANY_CODE#', GIVE_USER_ID, '#LANGUAGE#') AS GIVE_USER_NAME ,RECE_COMPANY_CODE ,RECE_USER_ID ,#DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME('#HOUSE_CODE#', '#COMPANY_CODE#', RECE_USER_ID, '#LANGUAGE#') AS RECE_USER_NAME ,START_DATE ,END_DATE ,DESCRIPTION ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,DELEGATION_KEY FROM SMAND WHERE 1=1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND MAND_TYPE LIKE '%' || NVL($S{F_MAND_TYPE}) || '%' AND GIVE_USER_ID LIKE '%' || NVL($S{F_GIVE_USER_ID}) || '%' AND RECE_USER_ID LIKE '%' || NVL($S{F_RECE_USER_ID}) || '%' AND DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || NVL($S{F_DESCRIPTION}) || '%' AND ( 1 = 1 AND ( START_DATE BETWEEN $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ) OR ( END_DATE BETWEEN $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} ) ) AND ( UPPER(GIVE_USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(RECE_USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(START_DATE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(END_DATE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADD_DATE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADD_TIME) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(ADD_USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR 1=1 )
AND ( GIVE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} OR RECE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} ) ORDER BY START_DATE

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT GWGL.HOUSE_CODE , GWGL.COMPANY_CODE , SIAD.RE_FLAG , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ , GWGL.APP_TYPE , GWGL.APP_SUBJECT , GWGL.APP_CONTENTS , GWGL.APP_STATUS , GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY2 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY3 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY4 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY5 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY6 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY7 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY8 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY9 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY10 , GWGL.APP_USER_DATE AS REQ_DATE , GWGL.APP_USER_TIME AS REQ_TIME , GWGL.APP_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ , GWLN.APP_STAGE , GWLN.APP_TYPE AS APP_LN_TYPE , GWLN.APP_METHOD , GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID AS TAREGT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_DATE , GWLN.ACCEPT_TIME , GWLN.ACCEPT_REASON , CASE WHEN APP_METHOD = '03' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END REFERENCE_STATUS FROM SSIAD SIAD LEFT OUTER JOIN SGWGL GWGL ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = GWGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = GWGL.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 INNER JOIN SGWLN GWLN ON GWGL.HOUSE_CODE =GWLN.HOUSE_CODE AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = GWLN.COMPANY_CODE AND GWGL.APP_NO = GWLN.APP_NO AND GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ = GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ AND NVL(GWGL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' WHERE SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SIAD.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ = '1' AND GWLN.APP_TYPE != 'L06' AND GWLN.APP_METHOD IN ('01','04') )A ORDER BY A.REQ_DATE DESC, A.REQ_TIME DESC, A.APP_NO, A.APP_NO_SEQ

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT GWGL.HOUSE_CODE , GWGL.COMPANY_CODE , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ , GWGL.APP_TYPE , GWGL.APP_SUBJECT , GWGL.APP_CONTENTS , GWGL.APP_STATUS , GWGL.CURRENT_STAGE , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY2 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY3 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY4 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY5 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY6 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY7 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY8 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY9 , GWGL.SUX_WKEY10 , GWGL.APP_USER_DATE AS REQ_DATE , GWGL.APP_USER_TIME AS REQ_TIME , GWGL.APP_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , GWLN.APP_LINE_SEQ , GWLN.APP_STAGE , GWLN.APP_TYPE AS APP_LN_TYPE , GWLN.APP_METHOD , GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID AS TAREGT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_USER_ID , GWLN.ACCEPT_DATE , GWLN.ACCEPT_TIME , GWLN.ACCEPT_REASON , CASE WHEN APP_METHOD = '03' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END REFERENCE_STATUS FROM SSETL SETL LEFT OUTER JOIN SGWGL GWGL ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = GWGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = GWGL.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.SMR_NUMBER = GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 INNER JOIN SGWLN GWLN ON GWGL.HOUSE_CODE =GWLN.HOUSE_CODE AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = GWLN.COMPANY_CODE AND GWGL.APP_NO = GWLN.APP_NO AND GWGL.APP_NO_SEQ = GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ AND NVL(GWGL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' WHERE SETL.SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND SETL.DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND GWLN.APP_NO_SEQ = '1' AND GWLN.APP_TYPE != 'L06' AND GWLN.APP_METHOD IN ('01','04') )A ORDER BY A.REQ_DATE DESC, A.REQ_TIME DESC, A.APP_NO, A.APP_NO_SEQ

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMR_NUMBER , SEQ , RECENT , APP_STATUS , APPLY_FOR , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CONFIRM_USER_ID , APP_COMMENT , APP_NO , APP_NO_SEQ , APP_LINE_SEQ , RE_FLAG FROM SAPPP WHERE RECENT = 'Y' AND POSTPROCESSED = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} ORDER BY HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, SMR_NUMBER FOR UPDATE
